The '''Eighty-first Infantry''' was a division in the [[Republic Infantry]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Originally stationed on [[Voss]], the 81st Infantry and its commander [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Marshall]] aided [[Havoc Squad]] in attacking the [[Bastion (Corellia)|Bastion]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]].
